scenarios.name: Homepage navigation
scenarios.instruction: Open the PHPTravels website and verify that the homepage has loaded successfully.
scenarios.expected_outcome: PHPTravels homepage loaded with title 'PHPTRAVELS' and URL 'https://phptravels.net/'.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Page loaded successfully at https://phptravels.net/; page title and URL verified.

scenarios.name: Navigation discovery
scenarios.instruction: Inspect the main navigation and identify the available travel booking sections.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Discover travel booking sections (Flight Booking, Hotel Reservations, Tour Packages, Visa) via semantic roles.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Identified 7 unique travel booking navigation sections.

scenarios.name: Customer login discovery
scenarios.instruction: Find the customer login option and open the login form.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Navigate to login form via semantic login entry point; verify email and password fields visible.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Discovered login form at https://phptravels.net/login; email and password input fields verified visible.

scenarios.name: Customer authentication
scenarios.instruction: Log in using the provided customer demo credentials and verify that the customer dashboard is displayed.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Redirect to customer dashboard (/dashboard), title 'Dashboard', and visible 'Account Summary' / 'Dashboard' heading.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Authenticated successfully: URL 'https://phptravels.net/dashboard', title 'Dashboard', visible landmark heading confirmed.

scenarios.name: Travel search workflow
scenarios.instruction: Open the flights section, inspect the available search fields, and identify the origin, destination, departure date, and passenger controls.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Discover flight form controls (One Way/Round Trip, dates, passengers, Search button).
scenarios.actual_outcome: PARTIAL: Discovered 30 interactive flight controls; form submission withheld to avoid un-sandboxed live supplier calls.
scenarios.failure_reason: Form discovery verified; full live search execution withheld as non-sandboxed supplier booking flow.

scenarios.name: Dynamic DOM handling
scenarios.instruction: Open a travel search section, inspect its available controls, and verify that the runner can recover if the page dynamically rerenders.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Detect stale synthetic ref and recover via semantic accessible locator without failing.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Successfully recovered and clicked live node after synthetic reference invalidation.

scenarios.name: Invalid login handling
scenarios.instruction: Attempt a login using deliberately invalid test credentials and verify that the website displays an authentication error.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Authentication rejected; page does not redirect to /dashboard.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Invalid login successfully rejected; user remained on https://phptravels.net/login without dashboard grant.

scenarios.name: Assertion reliability
scenarios.instruction: Open the login page and assert that an intentionally nonexistent dashboard heading is visible.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Assertion fails; test framework correctly refuses to grant PASS for absent state.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Assertion correctly failed with visible state verification rejection.

scenarios.name: Ambiguous element handling
scenarios.instruction: Find the appropriate search or login button when multiple similar controls are visible.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Detect ambiguous candidates with tied semantic confidence; reject unsafe arbitrary selection.
scenarios.actual_outcome: Detected 2 matching controls; tie-breaker cleared target_ref and flagged ambiguity.
